scope: P1_PREPARATORY_ONLY; unloaded character.tap to registered ui.toast adapter, synthetic events only
hypothesis: A bounded adapter can connect a trusted target event to already-registered local feedback without scene rewrites or authority expansion.

baseline.detail: Module absent before implementation; tests could not load. This is a feature baseline, not an existing live scene regression.

patch: Add fixed character.tap/event to ui.toast/effect sequencing, two-contract preflight, target-bound immutable context, after-guard cancellation/disposal checkpoint, busy/reentry protection and redacted honest receipts.
expected_observable_change: Synthetic tap produces feedback only after registered event returns true; false/invalid/cancelled/disposed events cannot produce feedback. No automatic scene listeners.

local_browser.observation: Pinned Playwright 1.56.1 available; Chromium 1194 and Headless Shell 1194 absent by filesystem checks; CI will install the locked browser, no unchanged launch retry.

contract_limits: Trusted application event source only; dispatch(target_id) is not proof of a real raycast or user gesture
Only existing registered local character.tap and ui.toast are callable; both receive {target_id}, ui.toast wraps local fixed feedback, not arbitrary card JS
Caller owns scene lifecycle and must abort/dispose on invalidation; async handlers must recheck before their own later mutations
No automatic event listeners, scene/joystick/camera changes, microphone, storage or network
Repeated distinct taps may dispatch again after completion; concurrent/reentrant calls are busy, there is no queue
Receipts keep runtime_verified:false; callback confirmation and synthetic DOM feedback are not P0/P1 real-event/device acceptance

unchanged: live HTML, public catalog, book/card IDs
GBA, GEN2, native permissions, public/private data boundaries and player saves
added: Unloaded adapter, nine Node tests and four synthetic DOM cases
